subject.title: Feature Request: Session rotation/archive lifecycle event for cron job triggers

question: Should session archive/rotation automation be supported as a core cron event schedule, a plugin lifecycle workflow with a narrow SDK seam, or left outside OpenClaw core?
rationale: Current main has adjacent cron and plugin lifecycle primitives, but the requested behavior would bless a new public automation and metadata contract with security and compatibility consequences.

options.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus a narrow SDK seam
options.body: Expose only the missing session/archive metadata and scheduling capability needed for plugins to implement event-driven post-session work without adding a new core cron schedule kind.

options.title: Add core cron event schedules
options.body: Make `sessionArchived` or `sessionRotated` a first-class cron schedule kind with durable event IDs, scoped metadata, authorization, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Keep it out of core
options.body: Document the current workaround of `session_end` hooks or startup analysis and decline a new lifecycle automation API for now.

recommendation.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus a narrow SDK seam
recommendation.body: Expose only the missing session/archive metadata and scheduling capability needed for plugins to implement event-driven post-session work without adding a new core cron schedule kind.

likelyOwner.reason: The recommended path is a plugin/SDK seam, and recent history connects this owner to plugin hook and compaction lifecycle work.
